title: Recording: Café On The Left Bank by Wings | 1977
content:
Fair Carol, St John, US Virgin Islands
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Mark Vigars

Wings continued recording the London Town song ‘Cafe On The Left Bank’ on 3 May 1977.

The session took place aboard the Fair Carol, a 105-foot yacht kitted out with studio equipment from the Record Plant in New York. It was initially moored in Francis Bay, St John, in the US Virgin Islands.

Although they failed to record a master take, Wings worked on the song throughout this day, with Paul McCartney on bass guitar, Jimmy McCulloch and Denny Laine on guitars, Linda McCartney on electric piano, and Joe English on drums.
